summary: Release rules are schema-bounded, authenticated, atomic, published successfully, and paired with an enabled production index. A two-phone physical-drive test remains recommended.

findings.issue: Firebase accepted the published rules and the required index is enabled; cross-device visibility has not yet been exercised during a real two-phone drive.
findings.recommendation: Test one short-lived report between two authenticated phones before broader field use.

findings.issue: Authenticated identity gives one response per UID, not proof of physical presence or a distinct real driver. New accounts could abuse reporting.
findings.recommendation: Add server-side rate limiting and App Check before public release; do not describe UID uniqueness as verified drivers.

findings.issue: Field sizes are bounded, but a user can create many report documents. Expiry hides reports without deleting stored data.
findings.recommendation: Add trusted per-user reporting quotas and a retention cleanup process before broader use.
